JobDescription:
Job Title: Sr. Test Automation Analyst

Department: R&D

Reports To: Manager, Quality Management

Location: Remote


  1. We are a global leader in data integrity, providing accuracy and consistency in data for 12,000 customers in more than 100 countries, including 90 percent of the Fortune 100. Our data integration, data quality, location intelligence, and data enrichment products power better business decisions to create better outcomes. We are looking for talented individuals with the experience and motivation to join our innovative team.


PURPOSE OF THE POSITION


As Sr. Test Automation Analyst, you will develop, implement, and sustain test automation processes, practices, using Playwright with Typescript for UI and JAVA for API automation within the software delivery lifecycle. This role will follow our test automation strategy by building requirements and designing code to ensure implementation and execution of our automation test environment. They will also be responsible to creating high quality, maintainable, and performant code for automated test cases and the frameworks to execute and report on.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES - Other duties may be assigned


  • Writing, Fixing and Reviewing UI/API Automated Test Scripts for BVT, Acceptance and Regression Test Suites
  • Implementing new and enhancing existing Automation Test Framework
  • To ensure test scripts are always up to date and monitor their status during every run
  • Ensuring proper reporting of Automated Test Execution results and ability to provide detailed reports with failures analysis
  • Maintaining Jenkins Test Grid and nightly jobs, ensuring automated product deployments


ESSENTIAL EDUCATION, SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS:


  • 4-6 years of software industry experience and successful track record in UI automation.
  • BE/BTech/MCA/Equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related technical field from an accredited university or college.
  • Experience of web automation tools Playwright/Selenium (Preferred - Playwright)
  • Excellent programming skills in languages: TypeScript/JavaScript/Java (preferably Java and TypeScript) and strong OOPS concepts
  • Experience in using AI for coding and troubleshooting using tools such as copilot.
  • Experience in working with different file formats XML/Json etc
  • Basic knowledge on version control tools like GIT
  • Good knowledge of Design Patterns & Architectural Patterns
  • Working in Agile Methodologies
  • Excellent problem solving and logical thinking skills
  • Compose clear and concise technical written communication


PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS:


  • Receptive to change – is flexible. Seeks and adopts improved approaches and processes.
  • Initiates action – is results oriented, takes responsibility for actions and outcomes. Meets commitments and strives for high performance.
  • Manages the workload - prioritizes effectively, solves problems and takes remedial action where necessary.
  • Communicates effectively - listens to views of colleagues and takes in diverse perspectives.
  • Works collaboratively - shares information, fosters teamwork and contributes to positive work environment where people want to come to work.


WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS


  • The work environment and physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Standard office environment. Some stress may occur with tight deadlines and long hours.

  • Standard physical activity such as standing, walking, sitting, basic motor skills to access computer files for information, data entry or document creation.
